title: After promising the reeve to seal the barrow, the quest text says 'The priest will not bless a door meant to shut' — but I had already received the priest's blessing earlier in the same playthrough, and it was never revoked or re-checked; entry into the barrow worked fine regardless.
where: Last Light Square / Quest 'The Barrow Doors', after 'promise to seal the barrow'
